subject: general
question: Which canal brought considerable greenery to Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Indira Gandhi canal**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An important irrigation canal in India is the** Indira Gandhi Canal**.
 
• It begins in **Punjab's Firozpur** and ends with irrigation systems in **Rajasthan's Thar Desert.**
 
• **Seven districts in Rajasthan **are traversed by the canal: **Barmer, Bikaner, Churu, Hanumangarh, Jaisalmer, Jodhpur, and Sriganganagar.** Thus, **Rajasthan** now has more **greenery**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira Gandhi canal**

 
 
• The project formerly known as the** Indira Gandhi canal** was given a new name in her honour.
 
• The **Indira Gandhi Canal **project was **started in 1983 **and **finished in 2010** when **Manmohan Singh** was the **prime minister of India.**
 
• The **Indira Gandhi Canal, **which has a **length of 445 km,** was constructed to start agricultural operations in Rajasthan's fields.
 
• The Indira Gandhi Canal connects Punjab and Rajasthan over its length and was constructed using the Sutlej and Beas rivers.
